title: Dynamics of Majorana tetron qubits under quasiparticle poisoning
summary: We study the dissipative dynamics of a Majorana tetron qubit in the presence of extrinsic quasiparticle poisoning due to the coupling to external leads. From the Bloch-Redfield equation describing a finite-size topological superconductor hosting four Majorana zero modes and tunnel-coupled to fermionic reservoirs, we recover analytical expressions for the decoherence rate of a Majorana qubit at arbitrary values of the charging energy.
